shortDescription: Manage an alert definition for a specific service type. Akamai refers to these as user alerts. You need read_only access to the scope for the selected serviceType.

options.name: channel_ids
options.description: The identifiers for the alert channels to use for the alert. Run the List alert channels operation and store the id for the applicable channels.

options.name: description
options.description: An additional description for the alert definition.

options.name: entity_ids
options.description: The id for each individual entity from a service_type. Get this value by running the list operation for the appropriate entity. For example, if your entity is one of your PostgreSQL databases, run the List PostgreSQL Managed Databases operation and store the id for the appropriate database from the response. You also need read_only access to the scope for the service_type for each of the entity_ids.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier assigned to the alert definition. Run the List alert definitions operation and store the id for the applicable alert definition. Required for updating.

options.name: label
options.description: The name of the alert definition. This is used for display purposes in Akamai Cloud Manager.

options.name: regions
options.description: The regions to monitor for this alert definition.

options.name: rule_criteria
options.description: Details for the rules required to trigger the alert.

options.name: scope
options.description: The alert scope. Supported values include account, entity, and region. Defaults to entity.

options.name: service_type
options.description: The Akamai Cloud Computing service being monitored.

options.name: severity
options.description: The severity of the alert. Supported values include 3 for info, 2 for low, 1 for medium, and 0 for severe.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: status
options.description: The current status of the alert.

options.name: trigger_conditions
options.description: The conditions that need to be met to send a notification for the alert.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the alert definition ready (not in progress).

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for the alert definition.
